Albion is east Maple Ridge, around 240 Street and Lougheed Highway. The City lists the neighbourhood as "Albion/Kanaka" and its Official Community Plan (OCP) carries an Albion Area Plan, Chapter 10.2.

The North East Albion Area is bound by Kanaka Creek Regional Park to the north, existing Albion residential developments and conservation areas to the southwest, and rural residential developments to the east.
Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) runs along the south side, 240 Street is the main north-south road, and 102 Avenue and 104 Avenue run east-west through the residential area.
Cottonwood and East Central lie west along Lougheed Highway, Thornhill lies northeast, and the Fraser River forms the south edge.

The standard urban house zone here is RS-1 Single Detached Residential in Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, section 605, with a minimum lot area of 668.0 m², minimum width 18.0 m, minimum depth 27.0 m and maximum lot coverage 40%.
The Albion Area Plan's Low Density Residential designation corresponds to single detached development at a low-density urban standard with lot sizes at 2,000 m².
The plan's Low-Medium Density Residential designation covers single detached or duplex housing with lot sizes from 891 m² down to 557 m².
North East Albion's Single Family designation allows secondary suites and/or detached garden suites where zoning permits, with larger lots placed beside the eastern plan boundary.

blocks.text: Albion Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: One secondary suite per lot is permitted in Maple Ridge, inside the same building as the single detached house.

A suite must not exceed 40% of the total gross floor area of the building, must not be situated within the Floodplain Area, and needs a building permit; a business licence is required if there are two rental units on the property.
Any new development within 50 metres of a stream, wetland, pond or ditch needs a Watercourse Protection Development Permit, under Watercourse Protection Bylaw No. 6410-2006.

blocks.text: Albion Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Albion Fairgrounds hosts events year-round, and the Albion Sport Complex is home to Planet Ice and the Golden Ears Winter Club curling rink.

blocks.text: Albion Houses: development and new projects

items.t: The Albion Area Plan update was adopted October 28, 2025, after a public hearing on October 21, 2025; status: adopted.
The update's concept for southern North East Albion proposes townhouses along 248 Street and between 248 Street and 249 Street, as a moderate density increase.

Albion Flats, south of the residential area, is mostly in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), is in the Fraser River floodplain, and is currently considered unavailable for urban development and outside the Urban Area Boundary.
Maple Ridge's 2025 total residential mill rate is 4.1895 per $1,000 of assessed value on the City's 2025 Property Tax Rate Summary, of which the City general rate is 2.6648.
Maple Ridge's 2025 water flat fee on the same summary is $822.25 per parcel, with an additional-unit flat fee of $411.10.
For 2025 the City raised sewer rates by 23.5%, about $136 more for the average household, and water rates by 4.5%, about $35 more, citing Metro Vancouver regional wastewater costs.
Maple Ridge property taxes were due July 2, 2025, and the tax notice includes charges for utilities.
TransLink's Haney Place route diagram lists routes R3, 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791 serving the Town Centre exchange west of Albion.

Port Haney Station at 22300 River Road and Maple Meadows Station at 20010 Dunn Avenue are the West Coast Express stations serving the west side of the city, with weekday trains between Waterfront and Mission City.

blocks.text: Albion Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: A covenant on title identifies construction in the floodplain, and no habitable floor space may be located below the 6.7 m flood construction level on affected lots.
Check watercourse setbacks before planning an addition: a Watercourse Protection Development Permit is required within 50 metres of a stream, wetland, pond or ditch.
Check ALR status for South Albion and Albion Flats parcels on the Agricultural Land Commission map; the Flats are mostly ALR and outside the Urban Area Boundary.

blocks.text: Albion home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

78 houses sold in Albion with a median price of $1,244,000 (the middle half sold between $990,000 and $1,379,750), taking a median of 19 days to sell at 97.7% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $402 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median lot of 4,012 square feet.
